title: Regionalisation of Supply Chains and Impact on Singapore’s Trade and Logistics Sector
what_it_is: Regionalisation of Supply Chains and Impact on Singapore’s Trade and Logistics Sector

sections.label: GDP growth forecast downgrade
sections.summary: MTI downgraded Singapore's GDP growth forecast for this year from -4% to -1%, to a new range of -7% to -4%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Earlier today, MTI announced a downgrade of Singapore’s GDP growth forecast for this year from -4% to -1%, to the new range of -7% to -4%.

sections.label: Supply chain connectivity initiatives
sections.summary: Singapore worked with other countries on supply chain connectivity, signing a declaration with New Zealand and working with ASEAN and RCEP.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Amidst the pandemic, Singapore has been working closely with other like-minded countries on various initiatives to ensure supply chain connectivity.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We issued a Joint Ministerial Statement with 10 other countries to affirm our commitment to ensure supply chain connectivity and to refrain from imposing export restrictions on essential goods.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: As a concrete follow-up of this initiative, we have signed a declaration with New Zealand to eliminate customs duties, not restrict exports of essential medical products, as well as expedite clearances of these goods through sea and air ports.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We are similarly working with our fellow ASEAN countries to ensure the continued supply of essential goods, and remain fully committed to signing the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) this year.

sections.label: Port volume drop cause
sections.summary: The recent weeks' drop in port volume is attributed to the global fall in demand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The short-term forces that see a drop in the port volume in the recent weeks can be attributed to the global fall in demand.

sections.label: Tuas port and ASEAN connectivity
sections.summary: ASEAN connectivity will boost port operations when things stabilise, and Singapore is optimistic about Tuas port's long-term role.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: The connectivity within ASEAN, within this region, will provide greater impetus for our port operations when things stabilise, all else being equal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: So, our investment in the Tuas port over the long term, we are optimistic that we will continue to play a significant role in the regional logistics chain and also as part of the global logistics chain.

sections.label: Working with Chinese companies
sections.summary: Singapore will continue exploring working with Chinese companies, seeing opportunities as the global supply chain shifts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: And we will continue to explore working with the Chinese companies as they continue to venture out.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: So, while the overall global supply chain network will shift towards a much more resilient one, I think it is not a zero-sum game and there are certainly opportunities for Singapore.

sections.label: Resilience and trusted hubs
sections.summary: Companies seek trusted hubs protecting IP, talent and exports, opportunities that play to Singapore's strengths.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: When they look at resilience, they are looking at not just the lowest cost competitor, but they are also looking for places where they can put their operations, where their intellectual property (IP) can be protected, their talent can come together, and perform product design and services; they are looking at trusted hubs whereby their exports will not be restricted because of policy-induced choices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: These are all opportunities that play to Singapore's strength as a trusted hub, as a safe harbour for talent and IP.
